news.title: Connor Brown's third-period goal lifts Devils to a 5-3 comeback win over Flames
news.ruTitle: Гол Коннора Брауна в третьем периоде позволил "Девилз" одержать камбэк-победу над "Флэймз" со счетом 5:3.
news.description: — Connor Brown scored the go-ahead goal off a scramble in front with 3:58 remaining to lead the New Jersey Devils to a come-from-behind 5-3 win over the Calgary Flames on Friday.

news.title: Trocheck's shootout goal lifts Mammoth to a 6-5 win over the Predators
news.ruTitle: Гол Трочека в серии пенальти позволил Мамонту одержать победу над «Хищниками» со счетом 6–5.
news.description: — Vincent Trocheck scored the only goal of the shootout and the Utah Mammoth beat the Nashville Predators 6-5 on Friday.

news.title: Morgan Rielly scores twice as Maple Leafs defeat Bruins, who lose David Pastrnak to injury
news.ruTitle: Морган Рилли забил дважды, когда «Мэйпл Лифс» победили «Брюинз», которые проиграли Давиду Пастрняку из-за травмы
news.description: — Morgan Rielly scored his first two goals of the season, including the 100th of his career, to lead the Toronto Maple Leafs to a 3-1 victory over the Boston Bruins on Friday.
